sentences.text: In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
The learning rate was set to 0.0003 with the Adam optimizer.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 16 GB of memory.
Figure 1 shows the test accuracy during training.
From epoch 18 to epoch 30, the test accuracy of Transformer improves by a relative 6.0%.
From epoch 12 to epoch 22, the test accuracy of CNN improves by a relative 5%.
At epoch 26, Transformer is 6.6 points better than DistilBERT.
As shown in Figure 1, from epoch 20 to epoch 26, the test accuracy of DistilBERT improves by a relative 1.7%.
Figure 2 shows the test accuracy during training.
As shown in Figure 2, at epoch 60, VGG-16 is 3.8 points better than ResNet-18.
As shown in Figure 2, ResNet-18 reaches over 70% test accuracy at epoch 20.
Figure 3 shows the f1 score during training.
As shown in Figure 3, ResNet-50 outperforms ResNet-18 by 19 percentage points at epoch 16.
At epoch 8, ResNet-18 achieves 67.7% F1 score.
As shown in Figure 3, ResNet-18 reaches 73.0% F1 score at epoch 14.
On CIFAR-10, SVM obtains an accuracy of 83.6%.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
